info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: listDocuments returns the caller org's generated documents, most recent first,
get.description:
listDocuments returns the caller org's generated documents, most recent first,
without their rendered bodies.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the rows returned; 0 means the store's own default.

post.summary: generateDocument renders a document from a template and merge data (a pure,
post.description:
generateDocument renders a document from a template and merge data (a pure,
deterministic render), seals it in the org's store and audits the generation.
It fails closed on a missing merge field — no blank contract — and the rendered
body carries the counsel-review notice whenever the template requires it.

get.summary:
getDocument returns one of the caller org's documents including its rendered
body.
get.description:
getDocument returns one of the caller org's documents including its rendered
body. A document belonging to another org reads as not found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the document id from the path, as returned by generate.

post.summary: requestSign opens an e-signature request over one of the caller org's documents
post.description:
requestSign opens an e-signature request over one of the caller org's documents
through the configured provider, and moves the document to out_for_signature.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the document id from the path; a body value is ignored.

post.summary:
completeSign records signature completion for a document that has an open
request — the signal a provider webhook or a reviewer sends.
post.description:
completeSign records signature completion for a document that has an open
request — the signal a provider webhook or a reviewer sends. The provider's own
status is checked first; an explicit signed value in the body overrides it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the document id from the path; a body value is ignored.

get.summary: listFilings returns the caller org's filing records, most recent first.
get.description: listFilings returns the caller org's filing records, most recent first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit caps the rows returned; 0 means the store's own default.

post.summary:
createFiling records a filing of one or more of the caller org's documents and
submits it through the filing seam.
post.description:
createFiling records a filing of one or more of the caller org's documents and
submits it through the filing seam. The platform does not file autonomously:
with no partner wired the honest status is "manual".

get.summary: health reports that the legal surface is serving and how many built-in
get.description:
health reports that the legal surface is serving and how many built-in
templates the library ships.

get.summary: listTemplates returns the template library resolved for the caller's org — the
get.description:
listTemplates returns the template library resolved for the caller's org — the
builtins with the org's own overrides substituted in — as metadata and merge
fields, without the template bodies.

get.summary: getTemplate returns one template resolved for the caller's org — the org's
get.description:
getTemplate returns one template resolved for the caller's org — the org's
override if it has one, else the builtin — including the template body.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the template id from the path.

put.summary:
overrideTemplate saves an org-specific version of a template (a custom NDA, say)
and returns it at its new version.
put.description:
overrideTemplate saves an org-specific version of a template (a custom NDA, say)
and returns it at its new version. The body must parse and may reference only
declared fields; a formation or equity template always keeps the counsel-review
notice, which an override can raise but never drop.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the template id from the path; a body value is ignored.

signed.description:
Signed overrides the provider's own answer when present. Absent, the
provider's reported status decides.

Body is the rendered document, sealed at rest and returned only to the
owning org. It carries the counsel-review notice when the template requires it.

esignProvider.description: EsignProvider is the provider holding the signature request, when one is open.

signedAt.description: SignedAt is the unix second the signature was recorded, once signed.

status.description: Status is the lifecycle state: draft, out_for_signature, signed or voided.

templateId.description: TemplateID is the template it was rendered from.

templateVersion.description: TemplateVersion is that template's version at render time.

updatedAt.description: UpdatedAt is the unix second of the last lifecycle change.

filing.description:
DocumentFiling is the tracking record. Its status is "manual" — file through your
registered agent — until a filing partner is wired.

data.description:
Data supplies one value per declared merge field. Every declared field is
required — a missing one is refused rather than rendered as a blank.

templateId.description: TemplateID is the template to render, required.

document.description: Document is the rendered document, including its content.

templates.description: Templates is how many built-in templates the library ships.

body.description:
Body is the text/template source, required. It may reference only the
declared fields — an undeclared one is refused rather than rendered blank.

category.description:
Category is the corporate need it serves; inherited from the builtin when
overriding one, and required otherwise.

counselReview.description:
CounselReview requests the counsel-review notice. It can be raised but never
lowered: a formation or equity template always carries the notice.

fields.description: Fields declares the merge fields the body consumes; all are required at render.

esignRef.description: EsignRef is the provider's reference for the open request.

provider.description: Provider is the e-signature provider that holds it.

signed.description:
Signed is true once the signature is recorded; false leaves it out for
signature, unchanged.

CounselReview marks a template whose rendered document carries the mandatory
counsel-review notice.

fields.description: Fields are the merge fields the template consumes; all are required.

id.description: ID is the template id, the value every other template route takes.

title.description: Title is the template's human title.

version.description: Version increments on each org override; a builtin is version 1.
